# CONV-14: interchange path-safety + package manifest + preflight decision
# core ported from paleo_workbench/interchange (full-conversion plan M9
# first slice). Qt-free, Python-free; frozen against the Python oracle
# generated by tools/oracle/generate_interchange_fixtures.py.
#
# CONV-14b extends the lib with the archive/OS/container half:
# native zip container (system zlib; deflate via raw deflate stream),
# atomic file publication, package builder/verifier runtime and the
# FLAC3D/Abaqus model adapters (reusing the CONV-22 geomodel writers),
# frozen against tools/oracle/generate_interchange_archive_fixtures.py.
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
add_library(pwb_interchange STATIC
    src/unicode.cpp
    src/path_safety.cpp
    src/manifest.cpp
    src/preflight.cpp
    src/contracts.cpp
    src/zip_archive.cpp
    src/atomic_file.cpp
    src/package_runtime.cpp)
add_library(Pwb::Interchange ALIAS pwb_interchange)
target_include_directories(pwb_interchange PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
target_compile_features(pwb_interchange PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
if(NOT TARGET Pwb::Domain)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "pwb_interchange requires Pwb::Domain "
        "(configure with -DPWB_BUILD_DATA=ON)")
endif()
target_link_libraries(pwb_interchange PUBLIC Pwb::Domain ZLIB::ZLIB)

# model_adapters/service reuses the CONV-22 geomodel export writers (never a
# re-implementation). Kept OPTIONAL so pre-existing consumers of the pure
# path-safety/manifest/preflight kernel (e.g. the CONV-21 prediction slice)
# keep configuring unchanged without the geomodel half on.
if(TARGET Pwb::GeoModel)
    target_sources(pwb_interchange PRIVATE src/model_adapters.cpp src/service.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(pwb_interchange PUBLIC Pwb::GeoModel)
else()
    message(STATUS
        "pwb_interchange: Pwb::GeoModel not present; conv-14b model "
        "adapters/service are disabled (configure -DPWB_BUILD_CONV_22=ON)")
endif()

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_subdirectory(interchange_tests)
endif()
